column3: Getting the Gifts, and...
Kousaka, you really bought a lot of souvenirs.
So did you; don't be making comments about others.
Akagi and I had both of our hands full with bags of souvenirs.
These are gifts for my sister and her friends.
Heh! You sure are 【popular】!
Nicely said for someone who's 100 times more popular.
Anyway, I bought your sister a present too.
Huh? What's that, Kousaka? Don't tell me you're aiming for my sister?!
He suddenly turned aggressive. This siscon bastard...
As a senpai in the same club as her, I at least have to buy her a souvenir.
Is that so? Then that's fine.
...It gives me shivers just thinking about you as my brother-in-law.
Same here.
Ah, Kyou-chan!
Oh, Manami, so you've already taken a bath...
Yeah.
A faint fragrance of shampoo drifted from Manami's hair...
M-My heart didn't skip a beat or anything...
Right, right. I have some things to talk to you about later; is it all right?
...Things?
Yes. After dinner.
Y-Yeah... Okay...
I'll be waiting for you here.
I came back here right after eating...
Besides, what does Manami want to talk about?
Something crossed my mind thinking about it. .
On the night of the trip
A single man being called out
by his childhood friend just out of the bath
The bath has nothing to do with it!
It's bad. I can't shake Manami's figure from my head!
But we're comfortable with our current ties!
That kind of stuff...
That's....
So you came first, Kyou-chan.
Ah! Yeah! That's right! A moment ago!
W-Why am I shaking? Calm down!
Can you take a look at this?
Huh? Isn't this a protective talisman...?
Yeah. I bought at the place we went together.
A-And this is...?
I wish to give this to Kyou-chan.
For me?
Kyou-chan doesn't seem careful; it can be dangerous, you know.
I am quite worried about you.
Silly...
Even if you don't worry about me, I can handle myself!
Really?
Yeah. I've been getting along with Kirino recently too.
So rest assured, just be the same as always.
...Well, thanks for worrying anyway.
Ehehe, you're welcome.
